item.title: Initialize Amazon S3 Data Lake
item.description:
Amazon S3 will act as the central storage repository (Data Lake) containing all raw and transformed data for the system.

Initialization steps

  1. Access the Amazon S3 service on the AWS Console and click the Create bucket button.
  2. In the Bucket name field, enter a unique name (for example: clickstream-datalake-v2-yourname).
  3. In the AWS Region field, select ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) to optimize latency.
  4. Keep the other default settings (ensure Block Public Access is turned on for data security) and click Create bucket.

item.title: Initialize AWS Glue Catalog
item.description:
In order for Kinesis Firehose to compress data from unstructured JSON to the Apache Parquet highly compressed columnar format directly on the stream, it needs a “blueprint” to know which columns the data contains. We will solve this problem using AWS Glue Data Catalog (Including Database and Crawler).

Step 1: Create Database

Step Action Technical details
1 Access service In the AWS Console, search for and open AWS Glue.
2 Go to Data Catalog On the left menu, select Databases and click Add database.
3 Declare name Enter the name clickstream_db and click Create database.

Step 2: Create structure table with Crawler (Schema-on-Read technique)

To get an accurate table to pass to Firehose, the smartest way is to let a Crawler test read a sample JSON file.

item.title: Set up SNS Notification Channel
item.description:
A complete automated system must have the ability to self-report results (Self-reporting). We will set up Amazon SNS (Simple Notification Service) to send an Email immediately when the data pipeline finishes running.

Setup steps

  1. Access the Amazon SNS service, select Topics on the left menu and click Create topic.
  2. Select the Topic type as Standard.
  3. Name: Enter the name Pipeline_Completion_Alert. Scroll down to the bottom and click Create.
  4. The Topic details screen appears, scroll down to the Subscriptions section and click the Create subscription button.
  5. Protocol: Click the dropdown arrow and select Email.
  6. Endpoint: Enter your personal Email address. Then click Create.
  7. Open your Email inbox, find the email from AWS Notification and click on the Confirm subscription link to activate the channel to receive messages.
